About this Event

BOLLYWOOD NIGHT FT. DJ AMIT
Get ready to dance the night away with the hottest Bollywood beats spun live by DJ Amit! Join us for an epic in-person party where the energy is high and the vibes are amazing. Whether you love classic hits or the latest chartbusters, this night is all about fun, music, and unforgettable memories. Don’t miss out on the ultimate Bollywood experience!
